errors.text_span: 图表中有两组并排的柱状图
errors.evidence: The chart contains three groups of bars corresponding to the three categories on the x-axis (近, 中, 远), not two.
In the '近' (Near) category, the bar for the '基线模型' (baseline model) is at exactly 59.0%, not 58.8%.
In the '中' (Middle) category, the value for the '基线模型' (baseline model) is approximately 58.6-58.7%, not 58.4%. The bar is visibly above the midpoint between 58% and 59%.

errors.text_span: 远距离时两方法的 F1 值分别约为 58.2% 和 55.6%
errors.evidence: For the '远' (Far) category, the values are approximately 58.9% and 56.2%. The reported values are significant underestimates. The value 55.6% is particularly incorrect as the corresponding bar is clearly above the 56% line.
